edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.population: adults living in homes with elevated radon
edges.mechanism: Radon decay products emit alpha particles that deliver concentrated DNA damage to bronchial epithelium, the key mechanism behind residential radon-associated lung cancer.
edges.summary: What makes this pair believable is not one flashy paper but the way the literature stacks up: the 2025 Lesbek meta analysis in Biomedicines already points to residential radon exposure tracks with higher risk or worse outcomes, and later studies mostly refine the size of the effect rather than overturning it. In practice this reads more like a real risk signal than a one-off finding.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
